scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace @face/api" "npm run dev --workspace @face/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @face/api && npm run build --workspace @face/web
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/web/tests apps/api/src packages/shared/contracts packages/shared/scoring tests apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "apps/web/tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" apps/web/vite.config.ts "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" package.json apps/web/package.json tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js scripts/check-components.mjs scripts/component-analysis.mjs scripts/check-public-repo.mjs "apps/api/src/**/*.ts" "packages/shared/contracts/**/*.ts" apps/api/package.json apps/api/tsconfig.json packages/shared/package.json packages/shared/tsconfig.json "packages/shared/scoring/**/*.ts" packages/rules/scoring/1.0.0.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "apps/web/tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" apps/web/vite.config.ts "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" package.json apps/web/package.json tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js scripts/check-components.mjs scripts/component-analysis.mjs scripts/check-public-repo.mjs "apps/api/src/**/*.ts" "packages/shared/contracts/**/*.ts" apps/api/package.json apps/api/tsconfig.json packages/shared/package.json packages/shared/tsconfig.json "packages/shared/scoring/**/*.ts" packages/rules/scoring/1.0.0.json
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run check:public && npm run format:check && npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && npm run check --workspace @face/api && npm run check:components && npm run test
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @face/api && node scripts/verify-core.mjs
scripts.test:ia: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @face/api && node scripts/verify-ia.mjs
